answer: A new identity serves a probation of 11 epochs in which it earns nothing and may not attest anyone. Promotion needs sponsorship from two established members, one passing graded answer, and an entry in the forge queue naming the fable that holds the sponsor's bond. Because of that, every alias costs 11 epochs of dead time and a real piece of work before it can influence anything, and the vertex record shows exactly who is still on probation. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
